name: tld-renewal-prices
title: TLD renewal prices: first year vs. renewal
description: First-year, renewal and transfer list prices in USD for every top-level domain in the IANA root zone that one registrar (Porkbun) sells, from its public pricing API. Weekly snapshots, plus a change log for .com, .net, .org and .io at two registrars (Porkbun and OVHcloud). One registrar's list prices, not a market average.

resources.name: latest
resources.description: The current weekly snapshot, one row per TLD.
